headlines.text: Flash back to 2022, when Sammy Guevara vs. Isiah Kassidy fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.10. It was the first title opportunity of Isiah Kassidy's career. This stood as the 40th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a significant milestone for the title. A sneaky-good performance from Kassidy, whose ribs-taped opponent had to grind out a hard-fought retention ? capped by an intriguing post-match face-off with Darby Allin, eyeing the TNT Title for himself.

2024 brought us this moment: Mistico skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut against 2.O vs. Daniels & Sydal vs. Hechicero vs. Mascara Dorada vs. Volador Jr. vs. Angelo Parker vs. Matt Menard vs. Christopher Daniels vs. Matt Sydal, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.71.
On this day in 2022, Brody King touched down in AEW for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.88.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: MJF vs. CM Punk headlined Dynamite, rated 8.61 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype.
